title: fat_proc_filter_dwis
description: Filter out user-found and user-defined bad volumes from DWI data sets.

input_dwi.description: Name of a 4D file of DWIs (required).
input_dwi.title: Input DWI

input_gradient.description: Bvec/bmat file from the gradients. Required. One of these options must be used: -in_col_matA, -in_col_matT, -in_col_vec, -in_row_vec
input_gradient.title: Input Gradient File

select_string.description: A string of indices and index ranges for selecting which volumes/grads/bvals to keep. This string gets applied to the volume, bval|bvec|bmat files for an input set. Either this or -select_file is required.
select_string.title: Select String

select_file.description: A file containing a string of indices and index ranges for selecting which volumes/grads/bvals to keep. This string gets applied to the volume, bval|bvec|bmat files for an input set. Either this or -select is required.
select_file.title: Select File

output_prefix.description: Output prefix for all the volumes and text files. Required.
output_prefix.title: Output Prefix

input_bvals.description: If the bvec/bmat is a file of unit-magnitude values, then the bvalues can be input.
input_bvals.title: Input Bvals

unit_mag_out.description: Ensure that the output grad information is unit magnitude.
unit_mag_out.title: Unit Magnitude Output

qc_prefix.description: Set the prefix of the QC image files separately.
qc_prefix.title: QC Prefix

no_qc_view.description: Turn off generating QC image files.
no_qc_view.title: No QC View

no_cmd_out.description: Don't save the command line call of this program and the location where it was run.
no_cmd_out.title: No Command Output

do_movie.description: Output a movie of the newly created dataset (AGIF or MPEG).
do_movie.title: Do Movie
